findings.claim: The new lookahead treats a bare U+20E3 (combining enclosing keycap) as an emoji anchor, so strings with no emoji base such as "⃣" or "‍⃣" still validate as emoji.
findings.rationale: U+20E3 is a combining mark and is itself in \p{Emoji_Component}. It only forms an emoji after a keycap base ([0-9#*], optionally followed by FE0F). Listing it as a standalone anchor lets through exactly the base-less component-only strings the change says it rejects. Fix: anchor on the sequence [0-9#*]️?⃣ instead of ⃣ alone.
